description: This file defines a Dojo widget class 'Todo' for managing individual todo items, including editing, saving, reverting, toggling completion, and removal functionalities within a TodoMVC application.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: A widget class representing a single todo item with editing, saving, reverting, toggling, and removal capabilities.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the widget, checks for 'todosWidget' property, and sets up computed observable for 'isEditing'.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Sets the original title and marks the current target as being edited.

methods.name: invokeSaveEdits
methods.description: Handles saving edits with deferred promise, ensuring saveEdits is called and its result is handled asynchronously.

methods.name: saveEdits
methods.description: Saves the edited title, updates the todo item, and manages the editing state, with special handling for blur and submit events.

methods.name: revertEdits
methods.description: Reverts the current edits, restores original title, and replaces the todo in the widget.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of the todo item.

methods.name: removeTodo
methods.description: Removes the todo item via the widget and destroys the widget instance.
